title: Asymmetric Discourse Homogenization and Shared Language Technology: Evidence from Reddit
abstract: arXiv:2608.13674v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: I document an ideologically asymmetric break in the pre-existing diversification trend of political discourse, emerging around late 2022, using 6 million Reddit comments from two cross-partisan forums, 2019-2025. Conservative users experienced an interruption of their prior diversification trajectory; progressive users showed no comparable change. The asymmetry is consistent across estimation strategies (ITS, DiD, RDiT, propensity-score matching) and temporal aggregations. A daily-frequency permutation test over 2,377 candidate cutoff dates shows the ChatGPT threshold produces an unremarkable estimate (49.8th percentile): the shift builds gradually instead of breaking at a single date. A continuous cumulative LLM index, tracking AI exposure across seven model releases, remains significant under a quadratic trend specification that eliminates the binary estimate. A stayer analysis narrows the mechanism: the homogenization effect disappe

translated_title: 不对称的话语同质化与共享语言技术：来自Reddit的证据
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.13674v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我利用2019年至2025年间来自两个跨党派论坛的600万条Reddit评论，记录了政治话语先前多元化趋势中一个意识形态上不对称的断裂，该断裂大约出现在2022年底。保守派用户的先前多元化轨迹被打断；进步派用户则没有表现出类似的变化。这种不对称性在多种估计策略（中断时间序列、双重差分、回归不连续、倾向得分匹配）和时间聚合方式下均保持一致。一项针对2,377个候选截止日期的日频排列检验显示，ChatGPT阈值产生了一个不显著的估计值（第49.8百分位）：这种转变是逐渐积累的，而非在单一日期发生断裂。一个追踪七次模型发布中AI暴露情况的连续累积LLM指数，在消除二元估计的二次趋势规范下仍然显著。一项留驻者分析缩小了机制范围：同质化效应消失……
tldr: 本文通过Reddit数据发现，2022年底后保守派政治话语的同质化趋势不对称地加剧，而进步派无此变化，且该效应由累积AI语言模型影响驱动而非单一事件。
en_tdlr: This paper documents an ideologically asymmetric break in political discourse homogenization on Reddit post-2022, driven by cumulative LLM exposure, with conservative users affected but progressives unchanged.
